edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC4 Each business rule of section 8 holds (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rules BR1 to BR9 of section 8 are in force
    When the rental stage runs
    Then each rule BR1 to BR9 is met as section 8 states it, with its values read from their owners

  Scenario: AC5 A provided operation answers 401, 403 and 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to a provided operation
    When it lacks valid credentials, lacks the right or names an unknown resource
    Then the operation answers 401, 403 or 404 respectively and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC6 A retried or timed-out activity is handled (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an activity of the rental stage fails or does not finish in time
    When its retry or its timeout is reached
    Then the activity is retried, and after the timeout the stage reports it to the parent
    Then the retry count and the timeout value are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3016-APP-AC6)

  Scenario: AC7 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the case model does not allow the status change
    When the stage reports its rule outcome to rwb-case
    Then rwb-case refuses the change, the case keeps its status and this stage writes nothing

| TC-E3-016-08 | AC4 | Component | Each rule BR1 to BR9 of section 8 is exercised at its owner: the RENTAL row and its values, the values read from their owners, the rollback when the decision record fails, the requests instead of writes, and no business event on the rental path |
| TC-E3-016-09 | AC5 | Component | A request to a provided operation without valid credentials is answered 401, without the right 403 and for an unknown resource 404; each refusal changes nothing |
| TC-E3-016-10 | AC6 | Component | An activity of the stage fails and is retried; an activity that passes its timeout is reported to the parent; the retry count and timeout value are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3016-APP-AC6) |
| TC-E3-016-11 | AC7 | Component | The case model refuses a status change it does not allow; rwb-case keeps the case in its current status, the stage writes nothing and the refusal is reported |
